newsitem.title: USA: Shell US Gulf gas plant outage to cut 130 mmcfd.
newsitem.headline: Shell US Gulf gas plant outage to cut 130 mmcfd.

text.p: Shell Midstream Enterprises said Thursday that next week's outage at its Yellow Hammer natural gas plant in Coden, Ala., will affect about 130 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of gas flows.
Some traders estimated this week that as much as 400 mmcfd may be cut when the plant is shut on Wednesday, October 23.
Gas deliveries are expected to return to normal by October 31, a company spokeswoman said.
The Yellow Hammer plant is located 11 miles north of Dolphin Island in Mobile Bay, she said.
Shell Midstream is a unit of Shell Offshore Inc, which is part of Royal Dutch Shell.
